facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.run_kitti_official_eval: run the KITTI official object detection evaluation on ground truth and detection annotations for car, pedestrian, cyclist classes
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.run_coco_style_eval: run COCO-style mAP evaluation with configurable IoU overlap ranges on KITTI ground truth and detection annotations
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.calculate_iou_partly: calculate IoU overlaps between ground truth and detection bounding boxes using image, BEV, or 3D metric
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.compute_image_box_overlap: compute 2D image bounding box overlap IoU matrix between two sets of axis-aligned boxes using numba JIT
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.compute_d3_box_overlap: compute 3D bounding box overlap IoU using rotated BEV IoU and depth intersection with numba JIT acceleration

facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.get_kitti_image_info: build a python module that loads KITTI image info with labels, calibration matrices, and velodyne paths for a dataset directory
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.get_label_annos: create a function that reads all KITTI label annotation files from a folder and returns parsed annotation dictionaries
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.filter_kitti_anno: build a python module that filters KITTI annotations by object class, difficulty level, and dontcare IoU threshold
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.iou: create a function that computes pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two sets of 2D bounding boxes
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.kitti_result_line: build a python module that formats a detection result dictionary into a KITTI evaluation result line string

facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.build_gpu_rotated_iou: build a python module that computes rotated bounding box IoU on GPU using rotate_iou_gpu_eval
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.create_iou_evaluation: create a function that evaluates IoU between two sets of rotated 3D boxes on GPU
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.test_rotate_iou_gpu_eval: test the rotate_iou_gpu_eval function with sample numpy arrays of rotated boxes
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.refactor_devRotateIoUEval: refactor the devRotateIoUEval CUDA device function to support additional IoU criteria
facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_par.review_rbbox_to_corners: review the rbbox_to_corners function that converts rotated box parameters to corner coordinates
